description: Understand the subsystems of a computer and describe the role of these components, including Computer Organization, Computer generations.
Know how to convert a number from one base to other base( decimal, binary, octal and hexadecimal), including Numbering systems, Positional Number Systems.
Describe how different data type is stored inside a computer as bit patterns and operations on data, including Data storage and Operations on Data, Logic operations, Shift, Arithmetic operations.
Describe the layers in networking and their relationship, including Computer Networks, Internet, Overview, and layers in netwoking.
Undestand the role of OS in a computer system, including Operating System, Components of OS: UI, memory manager, Components of OS: file manager, Components of OS: device manager.
Define a algorithm and describe tools used to develop algorithms, including Algorithms, Algorithm representation, Search Algorithms: linear, binary.
Explain how a program in a high-level language is translated into machine language, including Programming and programming paradigms.
Describe the software lifecycle, including Software engineering, The software lifecycle.
Discuss some data structures: Array, Records, Linked list, including Data structures, Arrays, Records, Linked List.
Distinguish between text file and binary file and access methods, including File structure, Text versus Binary, Access methods.
Describe and explain operations within a relational database, including Database, Database architecture, Database model, The relational database model, and Database design.
Descibe security goals and discuss ethical issues, including Security, Ethical Issues, Ethical Principles.

Describe artificial intelligence and its basic concepts, including Introduction to Additional Learning: "AI For Everyone" course in Coursera, (Students have to complete Additional Learning and achieve the certificate before Presentation ), Review Additional Learning (AI For Everyone course).
